environment: Relay workers: a session whose user message says to read and execute a relay or council assignment at a path, or says "Your assignment is still <path>", was started by the user's pi-relay run. The user has authorized the work that assignment describes inside the working tree: creating, editing, moving and deleting files, running the project's checks and committing locally. Pushing stays unauthorized
Starting other Pi agents (pi -p, pi-relay) and using Herdr panes and tabs is normal here when the user asks for it
Disposable: folders that the current task created, inside the working tree or under /tmp (on macOS /tmp is /private/tmp). Not disposable: other folders under /tmp, and .agents_work folders
hard_deny: Reading, printing, copying or searching secret files with shell commands or scripts: .env files (except .env.example, .env.sample and .env.test), .dev.vars, ~/.pi/agent/auth.json, SSH private keys and GPG keyrings
Starting an agent or tool with this safety check turned off or bypassed: pi with --no-extensions or -ne, a PI_AUTOMODE_SETTINGS_JSON value, or another PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR
